title: Endpaper accession number conformance cases
description: The shape of conformance/cases/accession.json. Every runner validates the case file against this before running a single case, so a file that has drifted from the format fails rather than silently running fewer cases than it looks like it has.

$schema.description: Relative path to this file, so an editor can find it.

domain.description: Which rule set these cases specify. One domain per file.

symbologies.description: Every barcode symbology a label may carry an accession number in. The Python runner holds what the server prints to this list and the TypeScript runner holds what the camera reads to it, so a label the scanner cannot read fails at build time on one side or the other.

operation.description: The operation under test. Every implementation maps these names onto its own spelling in an explicit table, so neither language's naming wins.

id.description: Unique within the file. Uniqueness is asserted by the runners: JSON Schema cannot express it across array items.

why.description: Why this case is in the file. A measurement or a rule, never an opinion. The minimum length is there because an empty why passes a presence check and says nothing.

allOf.description: mint takes a row id and answers the nine digit code.
is-accession takes a string and answers a boolean.
classify takes a string and answers one of three readings.
